prague-budget.answer: I could not get live November fares or hotel rates, so this is an estimate, not a quote. Flights: aggregator pages show Birmingham to Prague return from about £176 per person on easyJet/Jet2 (dates in late October, November is usually cheaper), so about £352 for two. Hotel: central 3-star doubles show around €65 a night, so about £170 for 3 nights. Food: roughly £30 a day each, £180 for three days. Total about £700, which fits £900 with about £200 spare. Confidence is low: check live prices before booking.

monday-train.answer: The latest direct CrossCountry train that gets you in time is the 08:01 from Birmingham New Street, arriving Manchester Piccadilly at 09:29. That is only one minute inside your 9:30 deadline, so a delay would make you late; the 07:26 is the safer choice. The journey takes about 1 hour 28 minutes. The walk from Piccadilly to the Manchester Art Gallery is roughly 10 to 15 minutes (about 1 km), so allow about 12.
